Any Growth engineer can approve it. The notifier has belonged to the Growth team since 2026-09-01, and copy and template changes are signed off in #growth-eng. That comes from the project's memory store, not from a file in the repo like a CODEOWNERS file.

An older memory said Dana Okafor had to sign off. That is out of date because Dana moved to Platform, so I marked it as challenged. It already pointed to the newer ownership memory as its replacement.

When you edit the receipt email, also follow the template convention:
- Templates live in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`.
- Each one needs a plain-text twin, `<event>.txt`, with the same variables.
- Variable names are snake_case.
